delta.description: Friendship points the bridge adds for this NPC when the player picks this choice; the brain clamps the model's number into -15..15. On the join choice it is the brain's fixed join gain, added for every happening participant.

join.description: Only on the one join choice, and only when happening is present.

bye.description: Only on the last choice of every reply that is not final: the brain's fixed goodbye. Picking it ends the conversation; the bridge shows closing and asks nothing more.

closing.description: The NPC's short parting line. Present exactly when bye is.

happening.description: Present only when one choice is a join choice: the player is talking to a participant at the happening's location during its window. Picking the join choice makes the bridge report a join event whose witnesses are these participants.
